fields.description: Soft limit on number of level-0 files. We start slowing down writes at this point. A value <0 means that no writing slow down will be triggered by number of files in level-0.

fields.name: rocksdb_cf_options.max_bytes_for_level_base
fields.description: Control maximum total data size for a level. max_bytes_for_level_base is the max total for level-1. Maximum number of bytes for level L can be calculated as (max_bytes_for_level_base) * (max_bytes_for_level_multiplier ^ (L-1))

fields.name: rocksdb_cf_options.max_bytes_for_level_multiplier
fields.description: we make last level the base level, which means merging L0 data into the last level, until it exceeds max_bytes_for_level_base. And then we make the second last level to be base level, to start to merge L0 data to second last level, with its target size to be 1/max_bytes_for_level_multiplier of the last level's extra size.

fields.name: rocksdb_cf_options.target_file_size_base
fields.description: target_file_size_base is per-file size for level-1.Target file size for level L can be calculated by target_file_size_base * (target_file_size_multiplier ^ (L-1))

fields.name: rocksdb_cf_options.target_file_size_multiplier
fields.description: By default target_file_size_multiplier is 1, which means by default files in different levels will have similar size.

fields.name: rocksdb_cf_options.max_sequential_skip_in_iterations
fields.description: This number specifies the number of keys (with the same userkey) that will be sequentially skipped before a reseek is issued.

fields.name: rocksdb_cf_options.max_write_buffer_number
fields.description: The maximum number of write buffers that are built up in memory. The default and the minimum number is 2, so that when 1 write buffer is being flushed to storage, new writes can continue to the other write buffer.

fields.name: rocksdb_cf_options.min_write_buffer_number_to_merge
fields.description: The minimum number of write buffers that will be merged together before writing to storage.

fields.name: rocksdb_cf_options.table_factory::block_size_deviation
fields.description: If the percentage of free space in the current block is less than this specified number and adding a new record to the block will exceed the configured block size, then this block will be closed and the new record will be written to the next block.

fields.name: rocksdb_cf_options.table_factory::block_restart_interval
fields.description: Number of keys between restart points for delta encoding of keys.

fields.name: rocksdb_cf_options.table_factory::block_size
fields.description: Approximate size of user data packed per block.

fields.name: rocksdb_cf_options.write_buffer_size
fields.description: Amount of data to build up in memory (backed by an unsorted log on disk) before converting to a sorted on-disk file.

fields.name: rocksdb_cf_options.level_compaction_dynamic_level_bytes
fields.description: If ON, RocksDB will pick target size of each level dynamically.

fields.name: rocksdb_cf_options.disable_auto_compactions
fields.description: Disable automatic compactions. Manual compactions can still be issued on this column family

fields.name: global.active_instance_count
fields.summary: number of active instances in the cluster database

fields.name: global.allow_group_access_to_sga
fields.summary: Allow read access for SGA to users of Oracle owner group

fields.name: global.approx_for_aggregation
fields.summary: Replace exact aggregation with approximate aggregation

fields.name: global.aq_tm_processes
fields.summary: number of AQ Time Managers to start

fields.name: global.archive_lag_target
fields.summary: Maximum number of seconds of redos the standby could lose

fields.name: global.asm_io_processes
fields.summary: number of I/O processes per domain in the ASM IOSERVER instance

fields.name: global.asm_power_limit
fields.summary: number of parallel relocations for disk rebalancing

fields.name: global.audit_file_dest
fields.summary: Directory in which auditing files are to reside

fields.name: global.autotask_max_active_pdbs
fields.summary: Setting for Autotask Maximum Maintenance PDBs

fields.name: global.awr_snapshot_time_offset
fields.summary: Setting for AWR Snapshot Time Offset

fields.name: global.bitmap_merge_area_size
fields.summary: maximum memory allow for BITMAP MERGE

fields.name: global.buffer_pool_keep

fields.name: global.buffer_pool_recycle
fields.summary: Number of database blocks/latches in recycle buffer pool

fields.name: global.cdb_cluster
fields.summary: if TRUE startup in CDB Cluster mode

fields.name: global.cell_offload_decryption

fields.name: global.cell_offload_processing
fields.summary: enable SQL processing offload to cells

fields.summary: client result cache maximum lag in milliseconds

fields.name: global.client_result_cache_size
fields.summary: client result cache max size in bytes

fields.name: global.cluster_database
fields.summary: if TRUE startup in cluster database mode

fields.name: global.cluster_database_instances
fields.summary: number of instances to use for sizing cluster db SGA structures

fields.name: global.commit_point_strength
fields.summary: Bias this node has toward not preparing in a two-phase commit

fields.name: global.common_user_prefix
fields.summary: Enforce restriction on a prefix of a Common User/Role/Profile name

fields.name: global.compatible
fields.summary: Database will be completely compatible with this software version

fields.name: global.containers_parallel_degree
fields.summary: Parallel degree for a CONTAINERS() query

fields.name: global.control_file_record_keep_time
fields.summary: control file record keep time in days

fields.name: global.control_management_pack_access
fields.summary: declares which manageability packs are enabled

fields.name: global.cpu_count
fields.summary: number of CPUs for this instance

fields.name: global.create_bitmap_area_size
fields.summary: size of create bitmap buffer for bitmap index

fields.name: global.create_stored_outlines
fields.summary: create stored outlines for DML statements

fields.name: global.cursor_bind_capture_destination
fields.summary: Allowed destination for captured bind variables

fields.name: global.cursor_invalidation
fields.summary: default for DDL cursor invalidation semantics

fields.name: global.cursor_space_for_time

fields.name: global.db_big_table_cache_percent_target
fields.summary: Big table cache target size in percentage

fields.name: global.db_block_buffers

fields.name: global.db_block_checking
fields.summary: header checking and data and index block checking

fields.name: global.db_block_checksum
fields.summary: store checksum in db blocks and check during reads

fields.name: global.db_block_size
fields.summary: Size of database block in bytes

fields.name: global.db_cache_size
fields.summary: Size of DEFAULT buffer pool for standard block size buffers

fields.name: global.db_domain
fields.summary: directory part of global database name stored with CREATE DATABASE

fields.name: global.db_file_multiblock_read_count
fields.summary: db block to be read each IO

fields.name: global.db_file_name_convert
fields.summary: datafile name convert patterns and strings for standby/clone db

fields.name: global.db_flash_cache_file
fields.summary: flash cache file for default block size

fields.name: global.db_flashback_retention_target
fields.summary: Maximum Flashback Database log retention time in minutes.

fields.name: global.db_index_compression_inheritance
fields.summary: options for table or tablespace level compression inheritance

fields.name: global.db_keep_cache_size
fields.summary: Size of KEEP buffer pool for standard block size buffers

fields.name: global.db_name
fields.summary: database name specified in CREATE DATABASE

fields.name: global.db_recycle_cache_size
fields.summary: Size of RECYCLE buffer pool for standard block size buffers

fields.name: global.db_ultra_safe
fields.summary: Sets defaults for other parameters that control protection levels

fields.name: global.db_writer_processes

fields.summary: Enable use of crypographic libraries in FIPS mode, public

fields.name: global.ddl_lock_timeout
fields.summary: timeout to restrict the time that ddls wait for dml lock
